book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.name: Birding Handbook
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.tooltip: A field handbook of the birds of this world
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.category.int: Meet the mod and the world of birds
Neo Guan Niao is a birdwatching mod rebuilt by 金子89, the author of this modpack, on top of Guaniao (yes, missing an n) originally created by EdDYON, and ported to 1.21.1 NeoForge.

Compared with the original mod, Neo Guan Niao has a complete set of its own core and control systems. Driven by each bird's data (200+ entries!), birds systematically show rich behaviours based on time, environment and ecology, with better compatibility inside modpacks.

Budgies, night herons, doves... the stars of the birdwatching world can be enjoyed in Minecraft too!

Pair it with multimedia mods for a better birdwatching experience.

The mod is still under development.

Neo Guan Niao project: https://github.com/Fodoth-jinzi89/NeoGuanNiao
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.unders:
Compared with vanilla mobs, the birds in this mod show much richer ecological behaviour.

You can also interact with them using special items and blocks!

Currently only the new-species birds' behaviour is maintained by the modpack author. Compared with old-species birds they behave more consistently and have fewer problems.

Tip: putting old-species birds into unnatural places such as compressed space may cause some behaviours to break.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.raisin:
All remade birds support taming and keeping.

With the breeding system you can not only obtain higher-rarity birds, but also produce more bird products!

You can move birds around with leads, Supplementaries cages, Apotheosis ender leads, Carry On, and so on.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.category.beh: What birds get up to all day long
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.moveme: When idle, birds move around at random, preferring high and safe places such as leaves and fences.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.daily_: Early to bed, early to rise

Diurnal birds look for a roost at dusk (usually high up in the leaves) and fly to it to sleep.

A sleeping bird will not perform most other behaviours.

If it cannot find one, it may sleep on top of any full block, and search for a better spot at longer intervals.

Chicks cannot fly, so they only sleep where they are.

At dawn the birds wake up, and adults fly a round to survey their surroundings.

Currently only the Night Heron is nocturnal, with the opposite schedule.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.lookin:
While awake, birds turn at random to look around.

Sometimes they turn their little heads more alertly, gathering information about their surroundings.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.feedin:
If food is lying on the ground as an item, a bird may come over and steal a bite.

They do not eat crops in block form, such as the crops growing in a field.

You can also throw food to feed them!

Breadcrumbs can be thrown directly by right-clicking, and are the favourite food of old-species sparrows.

All kinds of seeds can be fed to most birds.

Meat-eating birds like the Night Heron prefer fish.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.bird_b:
If you want to invite birds into your backyard, a bird bath is a great way to do it.

After placing a bird bath you can right-click it to put in up to 3 portions of food (breadcrumbs or fish) or 1 bucket of water. Birds will automatically find nearby bird baths and fly to them.

New-species birds stand on the rim to eat or drink and do not always consume the contents (especially small birds), and may hop off when they are done.

Old-species birds use it from the middle and always consume the contents.

Using it lowers the bird bath's cleanliness, and a dirty bird bath no longer attracts birds. Right-click by hand, or with a mechanical arm, to restore its cleanliness.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.startl:
Attacking a bird startles it, and nearby birds get startled as well.

A bird first gives you a puzzled look, then flies away.
Birds call out non-stop.

If you find some birds too loud, you can use ESM through the mute button in your inventory.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.skins_:
Birds have specific skins and models, and each skin and model has its own rarity.

Rarity:
Common < Rare < Uncommon < Epic < Mythic < Ancient < Unique

There is also a hidden tier that is not implemented yet.

A skin's rarity directly affects the quality of its feathers.

Some skins and models have special requirements (such as gender or chick). If a bird detects a mismatch, it will pick the closest correct version it can.

Currently Epic and above skins can only be obtained by breeding, never by natural spawning.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.follow:
Birds sometimes look for nearby creatures they find interesting and follow them.

Friendly birds like the Budgerigar follow players more often.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.flight:
Because we wrote a flight controller.

Flight behaviour is fairly consistent across species, only the speed differs. They will not rocket into the sky or fly out of your view, only at heights that make sense for the game. After flying for a while they try to land; if the landing spot is unsafe they take off again faster. After a successful landing they are too tired to fly for a while.

Birds also have some protection against floating oddly. For new-species adults, breaking the block under their feet may make them fly away. Chicks cannot fly and simply fall.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.dancin:
Just like in vanilla, the Budgerigar dances when a jukebox nearby is playing music.

This behaviour has a high priority and overrides other behaviours.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.taming:
You can tame a bird by right-clicking it with its favourite food.

Dropping food on the ground to feed it also raises a bird's trust, making taming easier.

Hurting a bird lowers its trust.

A tamed bird follows its owner. If you do not want it flying too high, lead it around with a leash.

By the way, a leash stops a bird from performing most behaviours, which is handy for keeping it in one place.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.bird_c:
Right-click a bird with a bird cage to catch it, then right-click the ground to place it again.

With Carry On installed, sneak-right-click a bird inside a cage to pick it up. You can also right-click a cage while carrying a bird to put it in.

Breaking a cage keeps the birds inside.

A small cage holds 1 bird, a medium cage up to 2 and a large cage 4.

You can also use them to catch other passive entities (adjustable in the mod config). Bigger cages can hold bigger creatures. These cages have complex models though, so catching complex entities and placing many of them can cost frames.

Caged birds are purely for show: they do not grow, moult, lay eggs or take damage.

The small cage can also be worn on your head.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.gender: The peacock flies southeast, lingering every five li

Birds are either male or female. For now the two behave the same and only look different.

Generally, males have brighter plumage and are a size larger than females of the same build.

For the Budgerigar you can also look at the colour of the cere (the part above the beak): blue is male, pink is female. This also generally holds for adult budgies in real life!

Birds like the Night Heron are hard to sex by appearance (true in real life as well — although with experience you can spot subtle differences in their plumage). You may have to feed and breed them to confirm their gender.

Wild birds' attributes cannot be analysed yet, but bred eggs show all of their attributes, which means you can learn the gender of every bird you breed.

You can name an egg with an anvil (or a name stamp template and such) to change the chick's name.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.breedi:
Birds can breed.

You need at least one male and one female, and feed each of them a bird food bag filled with the right food by right-clicking. Once the birds come close together and lots of hearts appear, they start breeding.

If there is a nest within 5 blocks of the female, she lays her eggs in the nearest nest she can reach. Without a nest, or if the nest is full, the eggs appear where the female is.

A nest holds up to 4 eggs and can be interacted with by right-clicking. Eggs in a nest hatch slowly until a chick comes out.
(In creative mode you can right-click the ground with an egg directly.)

Nests do not need birds to incubate eggs yet, and eggs never die, so you can distribute eggs to several nests with logistics to hatch more in parallel.

You can wear a nest on your head.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.geneti:
You may have noticed that a laid egg carries various attributes, and that its item texture changes with them.

An egg's model, skin, egg count, size, feather count and feather interval are all influenced by its parents. The first four vary around the parents' average; the last two work the same way but lean towards better values (more feathers, shorter interval).

Right now egg counts are 1~3, feather counts 1~10, and feather intervals 5~35 minutes.

Bird genetics are similar to Forestry beekeeping, but without dominant/recessive genes or mutation, which means every single bird is unique.

Getting the bird you want may take a long process of selective breeding.

Search for eggs in EMI to see every available egg type.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.chicks:
Birds come as chicks and adults.

Like vanilla animals, a chick matures 20 minutes after hatching and can then breed every 5 minutes.

Chicks can be tamed by feeding them the right food, and can also be grown faster.

Compared with adults, chicks mostly stay in the nest. They cannot fly, and once they fall out of the nest they cannot get back in (if you find a fallen chick in real life, carefully put it back into nearby grass and wait for its parents to help).

Birds like the Night Heron, whose chicks and adults have different skins, moult when they mature.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.category.foo: Food bags, feathers and villager trades
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.bird_r:
Its workstation is the bird nest.

It buys feathers and sells bird food bags.

It also sells some random bird eggs (not implemented).

It is currently the only villager that uses coins directly, and the only way to automate coins! You may want to build a feather farm.

The higher its level, the higher the rarity of the feathers it buys and the food bags it sells.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.feathe:
Currently only adult birds drop feathers, at a fixed interval, matching their species and rarity; this depends on their feather count and feather interval.

Killing a bird does not drop feathers!

You can collect them with any item-collecting method (magnet upgrades, maids, allays, dispersal nets, ender interfaces and so on).

Feathers can be traded to the bird keeper villager (workstation: bird nest) for tokens.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.green_: Used to adjust the attributes of new-species birds. Just right-click to feed (the bird must be awake and idle).
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.golden: Used exactly like the green food bag. Master-level bird researchers also sell it.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.growth: Feed to a chick to stop or resume its growth, similar to the golden dandelion.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.grow_u: Use on a chick to make the bird grow up immediately.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.rejuve: Use on an adult to turn it back into a chick and reset its growth time.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.feathe: Reduces the feather interval by 50 s per bag (never below the 5 minute minimum).
Increases the feather interval by 50 s per bag (never above the 45 minute maximum).
Gives the bird +1 feather (never above the maximum of 10).
Gives the bird -1 feather (never below the minimum of 1).
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.size_u: Gives the bird +0.05 size (never above the maximum size for that species).
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.size_d: Gives the bird -0.05 size (never below the minimum size for that species).
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.skin_u: Raises the skin's rarity by one tier (up to Ancient).
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.skin_d: Lowers the skin's rarity by one tier (down to Common).
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.unique:
Gives the bird a Unique skin, preferring one matching its own gender.

At the moment Cheng Heguang's Unique skins have unique models and cannot be obtained with this food bag.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.transm: If the bird's skin has a counterpart for the other gender (or supports the other gender), the bird is changed to that gender.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.category.spe: Habits and habitats of every species
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.specie:
The remade birds were redone or created by 金子89 and others.

After version 2.9 the mod removed the old species and migrated everything to the new birds.

Cockatiel: plains, sunflower plains, savanna, savanna plateau, windswept savanna, badlands, wooded badlands, eroded badlands.

Long-tailed Tit: forest, flower forest, birch forest, old growth birch forest, dark forest, grove, taiga, snowy taiga, old growth pine taiga, old growth spruce taiga, cherry grove.

Crow: forest, flower forest, birch forest, old growth birch forest, dark forest, grove, taiga, snowy taiga, old growth pine taiga, old growth spruce taiga, savanna, savanna plateau, windswept savanna, plains, sunflower plains, meadow, snowy plains, swamp, mangrove swamp.

Seagull: beach, snowy beach, river, frozen river, ocean, deep ocean, frozen ocean, deep frozen ocean, cold ocean, deep cold ocean, lukewarm ocean, deep lukewarm ocean, warm ocean.

book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.budger:
A very noisy little bird that eats seeds.

Spawns in plains, sparse jungle and similar places.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.sparro:
One of the most common birds, eats seeds.

Spawns in flocks in plains and forests, and sometimes in cold biomes.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.night_: Jade wings over a full pond

The only nocturnal bird, eats fish.

Found around rivers and lakes, with many variations.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.spotte: Dove calls in the drizzling rain

A chubby, goofy bird that eats seeds.

Spawns in plains and forests, preferring places with richer natural surroundings than the pigeon.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.pigeon:
A bird closely tied to human life, eats seeds.

Spawns in plains and forests, preferring places with more man-made structures.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.kiwi.p:
A flightless ground bird that eats seeds.

Spawns in forested regions.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.woodco:
A nocturnal bird that eats seeds and walks in a very funny way.

Spawns in forests and swamps.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.cockat:
A noisy little bird that eats seeds.

Their cheek patches are adorable!
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.long_t:
A little snowball that spawns in cold biomes.

Eats seeds.
A large parrot with beautiful feathers and a powerful bite. Spawns rather rarely in jungles.

Eats seeds.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.crow.p:
A colourful kind of black.

A common bird that spawns all over the world, eats seeds.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.seagul:
The whole point of being a seagull is to grab some fries at the pier.

Spawns by the sea and eats fish. You can also feed them the modpack's fries.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.myna.p:
A noisy city bird. It cannot be taught to talk yet. Eats seeds.

Spawns all over the world.
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.category.cam: Capture them with the Nikon camera
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.bird_p:
All credit to the original author for this digital camera! It is far more capable than the film camera from 拾光定影.

Press Alt + C by default to open the creative photography screen, where you can adjust focal length, aperture and other settings; press V to open the filter library with 50 filters to choose from!

The film you shoot can be combined with any block (unlike the original mod) to get a frame matching that block, then sneak-right-click to hang it.

Such a capable camera naturally costs a fortune, of course...
book.neoguanniao.bird_guide.entry.film_a:
Once you have film from the Nikon camera, it can be combined with 1~8 of any block to create a framed photo from 1x1 up to 8x8.

Right-click a wall to hang the framed photo (the bottom-left corner is where you clicked, and it needs enough space). Right-click again to rotate it, left-click to take it down.

Film and blank film can be combined to copy film.

Putting a framed photo straight into a crafting grid takes the frame off (the frame is not kept), or combine it with another piece of film to swap the photo (the old photo is not kept).
